title: Concept: Account lockout disabled
description: A lockout threshold of zero beside the login policy in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Without a threshold an attacker can keep guessing, and the policy response confirms the bank has no lockout to run into.
applicability: Deployments that render a lockout threshold of zero beside the login policy into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Without a threshold an attacker can keep guessing, and the policy response confirms the bank has no lockout to run into.
